task_completion.description: Agent opens the SAM (System Advisor Model) software or a Python IDE for PySAM.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot showing the SAM GUI interface or a code editor with PySAM imports (e.g., import PySAM.BatteryStateful).

task_completion.description: Agent sets the battery power to 200 kW and energy capacity to 400 kWh.
task_completion.visual_evidence: SAM 'Battery Cell and Pack' or 'Battery System' page showing 200 kW and 400 kWh (or 2 hours) values, or code setting these parameters.

task_completion.description: Agent creates or imports a load profile with 250 kW peaks (06:00-18:00) and 50 kW baseline.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Electric Load' page in SAM showing a diurnal profile with a 250 kW plateau, or code logic generating an 8760 array with these values.

task_completion.description: Agent selects the 'Automated Peak Shaving' dispatch strategy.
task_completion.visual_evidence: SAM 'Battery Dispatch' page with 'Automated Peak Shaving' selected, or PySAM code setting the dispatch mode to peak shaving.

task_completion.description: Agent saves the project file or Python script to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or terminal showing /home/ga/Documents/SAM_Projects/commercial_peak_shaving.py or Commercial_Peak_Shaving.sam.

task_completion.description: Agent saves the final results JSON with all required keys to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output displaying the content of /home/ga/Documents/SAM_Projects/peak_shaving_results.json containing battery_power_kw, battery_energy_kwh, original_peak_demand_kw, new_peak_demand_kw, peak_reduction_kw, and annual_load_kwh.

integrity.description: Verify the agent actually ran a simulation rather than just writing a JSON file with hardcoded values.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the 'Simulate' button being clicked in SAM, or terminal output showing the execution of the Python script.

integrity.description: Check if the agent manually calculated the 'new_peak_demand_kw' instead of extracting it from SAM/PySAM outputs.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Python script should show variables assigned from simulation output objects (e.g., out.Outputs.gen) rather than fixed numbers for the results.

integrity.description: Ensure the agent used the exact file paths specified in the instructions.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file paths in the code or save dialogs must match /home/ga/Documents/SAM_Projects/.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The facility has a 12-hour peak (250kW) and 12-hour base (50kW). Annual load is 912,500 kWh. Battery is 200kW/400kWh. The original peak is 250 kW. Because the peak duration (12 hours) is much longer than the battery duration (2 hours), the 'new_peak_demand_kw' should be between 180 kW and 240 kW (it cannot be reduced to 50kW). The JSON must contain exactly 6 keys: battery_power_kw (200), battery_energy_kwh (400), original_peak_demand_kw (250), new_peak_demand_kw, peak_reduction_kw, and annual_load_kwh (912500).
